papers.topic: MMA / TensorCore fragment layouts + shared-memory swizzle (Volta/Ampere/Hopper) — vendor spec, no paper
papers.verified: source-cited (docs.nvidia.com PTX-ISA URL in source; vendor spec, no arXiv/DOI)
papers.evidence: PTX-ISA URL written verbatim in Dialect.cpp:271. Box on TensorCore MMA fragments (each thread holds a fixed tile slice) + why shared memory is XOR-swizzled across 32 banks. Engineering, not a paper — grounds the MMA-layout / swizzle chapters.

papers.topic: FP8 element formats E4M3 / E5M2 (and FNUZ variants)
papers.evidence: Type set matches the paper exactly (E4M3 4-exp/3-mant drops infinities for range; E5M2 5-exp/2-mant). One box on sign/exp/mantissa budgets + FN/FNUZ special-value differences lets the reader follow per-encoding MMA-legality and upcast tables.

papers.topic: OCP Microscaling (MX/MXFP) — block-scaled E2M1/E4M3/E5M2 with shared E8M0 scale (UpcastMXFPOp)
papers.evidence: TritonGPUOps.td:266 externalizes semantics to the OCP MX spec. Box: 'a block of 32 low-bit elements shares one E8M0 power-of-two scale; upcast = decode element * 2^scale' — explains the scale operand and why E2M1 packs two-per-byte.
